name: Distort Reveal CRT
description: Long-form scroll layout of headings, paragraphs and images rendered through a WebGL CRT post effect with glitch, chromatic aberration, vignette and scanlines that distort text as it scrolls.
contents: Three sections with large headings, paragraphs and four images
Final overlay heading on top of the last image
behavior: Each image, heading and paragraph is rendered by VFX-JS with a random horizontal glitch shader
Whole page gets a CRT post effect with barrel zoom, chromatic aberration, scanlines, grid, vignette and dither noise
Original DOM elements are transparent, the WebGL canvas draws them
Text rows stack on screens under 640px

props.name: paragraph1Text
props.default: Obviously, this is just a test text — but how do you know? There is certainly a writer of this text, someone who exists. Even if it was automatically generated by some tool or AI, there must have been a text, somewhere, used as training material. So we cannot escape the spirit — the vibe — the shadow it casts. It comes from the soul, buried deep in unconscious limbo.

props.name: paragraph2Text
props.default: Somewhere between the folds, something breathes. Not a presence, but the memory of having been watched. Syntax curls back on itself, a serpent swallowing not its tail, but its own shadow. Read again. You missed it the first time. You always do.

props.name: paragraph3Text
props.default: And if the soul remains, so too does its intent — not always clear, not always benevolent. What was the writer thinking? Or worse — what was it trying not to think? Language is a veil, but veils are thin when backlit by desire, or fear, or guilt. Read carefully. Something watches back when you stare too long into a sentence.

editableByProps: All headings, paragraphs and image sources
Background, text and final heading colors
Font sizes, section width and vertical spacing
CRT effect strength: vignette, dither, chromatic aberration, edge distortion

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the glitch look of each element
